scope: Windows desktop prototype-host diagnostic; no optimization acceptance, architecture selection or target-device claim

plan.purpose: Characterize equivalent end-to-end prototype hosts before selecting a runtime or frame protocol
plan.ambientCpuPolicy: Observe three two-second system CPU intervals before each timing order. Record every processor's busy fraction; this is context, not proof of an uncontended machine. Run no concurrent build or verification jobs
plan.equivalence: Every timed sample must match all expected responses and the final checkpoint; batch sizes must produce identical flattened observations and state
plan.timingBoundary: Prebuilt requests through response delivery; setup, verification, reporting and process-memory queries are outside the batch timing interval
plan.checkpointBoundary: Restore, snapshot and destroy round trips, including handle decoding and request construction; validation is outside the interval
plan.initializationBoundary: Runtime/context and bundle initialization plus content parsing and controller construction, with file bytes already read
plan.memoryBoundary: Same Windows process-memory observer for both hosts; VM and managed counters are separately labelled and are not interchangeable
plan.gcPolicy: No explicit collection in throughput trials; separate memory trials collect the host heap after releasing caller input buffers and after disposal. Node collection includes V8; managed collection excludes the native VM, which retains its ordinary collection policy
plan.summary: Retain every sample; median, nearest-rank p95 and range per order, workload, host and batch size; no outlier deletion or pooled significance claim
plan.decision: Diagnostic characterization only. No optimization acceptance, architecture selection, whole-game frame budget or device-support claim
limitations: Windows desktop hosts, not Steam Deck or mobile hardware
.NET 8 consumer, not Unity IL2CPP or an engine editor/player
Selected gameplay capabilities and complete item/passive packs, not the entire game
Process initialization includes test-driver work and does not imply a cold filesystem cache
Private committed bytes and working-set bytes have different meanings
Node heap changes are not total allocations; tracked native allocation counts omit reallocations
Fixed warmup count does not prove JIT or GC convergence
Milestone 43 performance acceptance remains governed by its existing thresholds

priorMeasurement.reasonRetained: All samples retained. A final run followed stronger request-fixture and native-source seals, not a selection based on favorable timings. The earlier exact driver is in the raw archive.
